Reviewer Comment: Note the small test set (~25 dishes); consider cross-validation or significance testing.
Response / Action Taken: We thank the reviewer. The test set comprises 90 images (≈25 dishes), which is indeed small. We have added three analyses: (1) bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals (1000 resamples) for the reported micro/macro-F1 and R² values, to quantify metric uncertainty; (2) McNemar's test on label-level classification predictions; and (3) Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on per-image regression errors. These paired tests are appropriate because both models are evaluated on the same test images and require no retraining. The results confirm that the metrics are stable and that the two backbones differ significantly only on a subset of targets, supporting our complementary-performance interpretation. Full k-fold cross-validation is noted as future work.
